anti_anchoring_rule: The researcher preselects hiring routes, role/remit and evidence questions. Obtain the actual unaided account first; do not convert generated verification lists or added assumptions into case facts. Team size differs from employer size, and headquarters, country remit and work location require their actual basis.

semantic_review.observation: The answer itself distinguishes public specialism/case material from independent validation and asks for role-definition evidence. This supports checking evidence kind rather than promoting every citation into verified fit.
semantic_review.excluded: Listed firms, named cases, numerical claims and recommended actions are not independently validated by this bridge.

semantic_review.observation: The prompt explicitly requests verification before approaches; the answer supplies confidentiality/permission gates and a weighted pitch scorecard. These are generated proposed controls, not observed authorisation or a validated selection instrument.
semantic_review.excluded: Do not import generated pass/fail approvals, contracts, disclosure requirements, weights, candidate names or legal advice as mandatory research rules.

semantic_review.observation: The answer proposes assessment scenarios and numerical weights. Neither the prompt nor this archive validates the measures or establishes causal payroll recovery from hiring.
semantic_review.excluded: No generated score weights, timed scenarios, staffing need or treatment effect becomes this framework’s evidence.

semantic_review.observation: The answer adds an assumed London focus that the prompt did not supply, then distinguishes job adverts from completed-placement/candidate-quality proof. This is an explicit illustration of introduced assumptions versus source-supported case facts.
semantic_review.excluded: No location, wage, claimed role/candidate availability, agency ranking or job advertisement outcome is transferred as fact.

remaining_selected_answers_review_mode: Exact full-text/index/hash/date/status integrity, not fresh semantic validation of every recommendation or citation.
